translations.web: “ ‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.
translations.bsb: You must not lie with a man as with a woman; that is an abomination.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
